summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (proposed — not implemented)  I did a read-only audit of the full chain (`WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts`) to scope the fix before touching anything.  **What I found, already read-only:**  1. **The happy path is actually scoped correctly.** Every watchlist route requires a valid session (`handlers.ts:13-21`), derives `userId` from it, and every `SELECT`/`INSERT`/`DELETE` filters by `user_id`. The client has no localStorage/anonymous fallback — `activeId` comes only from the server response. `login()`/`s
